title: Invoice System
shortDescription: Subscription-based invoicing platform with a Laravel Octane backend, real-time WebSocket updates, and Razorpay payments.
description:
A subscription-based, feature-rich invoicing platform built for the OneGlobe group. Companies sign up, subscribe, and get a fully multi-tenant workspace where their admins can add and manage employees, CAs/accountants, and other roles across a wide range of billing and management features.

The backend runs on Laravel Octane for long-lived, high-throughput request handling, while WebSocket channels push live updates to every connected client — invoice status changes, payment events, and team activity appear instantly without refreshes. Razorpay powers subscription billing and ad-hoc invoice payments with full webhook reconciliation.

On the frontend, a Next.js + React application renders complex invoice builders, ledger views, and role-aware dashboards at a pace that keeps accountants happy during month-end crunch.
keyFeatures: Multi-tenant company workspaces with admin-managed employees, CAs/accountants, and custom roles
Real-time invoice and payment updates over WebSocket channels
Razorpay subscription billing with webhook-driven status reconciliation
Laravel Octane long-lived backend for high-throughput API responses
Role-aware dashboards covering billing, ledgers, and team management
Subscription plans with feature gating per company
challenges: The hardest part was making role-based data isolation airtight across a multi-tenant tenant-per-company model while keeping the API fast. A shared connection-per-channel WebSocket gateway plus strict policy middleware kept real-time events correctly scoped, and Octane's in-memory model meant carefully avoiding cross-tenant state leaks between requests.

title: NextGenTrip
shortDescription: Full-featured travel booking platform (hotels + flights) with TBO API integration, real-time pricing, and Stripe payments.
description:
NextGenTrip is a production travel booking platform covering hotels and flights end-to-end: search, availability, pricing, booking, and post-booking management. It integrates the TBO travel API for live inventory, layered with a real-time pricing engine that normalizes supplier responses into a consistent, cacheable format.

Payments run through Stripe with card capture, refunds, and partial-cancellation flows. A multi-role admin panel gives operations teams control over markups, policies, and booking states.

Performance was a hard requirement: Next.js SSR with aggressive caching on TBO responses and AWS S3-backed CDN for media delivers sub-2s page loads across the entire funnel, and the platform comfortably handles 500+ booking sessions per month.
keyFeatures: Hotel + flight search, booking, and management powered by the TBO travel API
Real-time pricing engine normalizing supplier responses
Stripe payments with refunds and partial cancellations
Multi-role admin panel for markups, policies, and booking operations
Sub-2s page loads via Next.js SSR and AWS S3 CDN
Handles 500+ booking sessions per month
challenges: Supplier APIs are slow, flaky, and inconsistent. I built a normalization and caching layer with graceful degradation — cached availability with explicit staleness indicators means a TBO timeout degrades the experience to slightly-stale pricing rather than a broken funnel.

title: Ben's Bento
shortDescription: Food ordering platform with a cross-platform React Native app, social feed, and a Laravel + WebSockets backend for live orders.
description:
Ben's Bento is a food ordering platform spanning three surfaces: a cross-platform React Native (Expo) mobile app for customers, a web dashboard for the business, and a Laravel + WebSockets backend that keeps everything in sync.

Customers browse menus, order, and follow their order status live — kitchen acceptance, prep, and dispatch events stream over WebSockets to the app in real time. Beyond ordering, the app includes a social feed where the community shares meals and reviews, plus deep profile customization (themes, haptic feedback toggles, and preferences).

The business dashboard handles menu/item management, order operations, and user tracking — built with the same design system as the public site for a cohesive feel.
keyFeatures: Cross-platform iOS + Android app built with React Native (Expo)
Live order status streaming over WebSockets
Social feed with meal sharing, reviews, and community engagement
Profile theming and haptic feedback preferences
Web dashboard for menu management, orders, and user tracking
Laravel backend with event-driven order pipeline
challenges: Mobile networks are hostile to persistent sockets. The app implements an exponential-backoff reconnect strategy with snapshot-resync on rejoin, so a subway tunnel never leaves an order stuck in a phantom state.

title: Krishna Invoice
shortDescription: Production invoicing system for e-vehicle dealerships with cross-platform web and mobile apps for quotes, ledgers, and live EMI tracking.
description:
Krishna Invoice is a production invoicing system purpose-built for e-vehicle (scooty) dealerships. Sales staff build quotes on web or mobile, convert them to invoices, and manage customer ledgers — while buyers on finance plans get live EMI and payment tracking pushed to the app.

The system ships as a React.js web app for the showroom and a React Native mobile app for on-the-go operations, both talking to a CodeIgniter (PHP) + MySQL backend. Role-aware permissions keep sales, accounts, and management views cleanly separated.
keyFeatures: Quote builder converting to invoices with dealership-specific line items
Live EMI schedules and payment tracking for financed purchases
Cross-platform React.js web app + React Native mobile app
Customer ledgers with aging summaries
Role-aware access for sales, accounts, and management
MySQL-backed reporting tuned for month-end queries

title: Event Management Portal
shortDescription: Multi-role event platform with six dashboards, Stripe payments, automated emails, and RBAC — supporting 1,000+ registered users.
description:
A multi-role event management platform serving six distinct dashboard types — Admin, Partners, Ambassador, Associate, Users, and Groups — each with tailored workflows and permissions enforced through strict RBAC.

Core flows include event registration with capacity management, Stripe-powered payments for tickets and packages, and automated email notifications across the registration lifecycle. The platform supports 1,000+ registered users and keeps every role's view fast with server-side pagination and targeted indexes.
keyFeatures: Six role-specific dashboards: Admin, Partners, Ambassador, Associate, Users, Groups
Event registration workflows with capacity management
Stripe payments for tickets, packages, and refunds
Automated email notifications across the registration lifecycle
Strict RBAC enforced at both API and UI layers
Supports 1,000+ registered users

title: SAF Demands
shortDescription: Demand and bidding platform with three-role dashboards, automated bid management, Airtable API sync, and cron scheduling.
description:
SAF Demands is a demand and bidding platform connecting customers posting requirements with providers submitting competitive bids. Three role dashboards — Admin, Customer, and Provider — cover posting, bidding, awarding, and auditing.

Automated bid management handles staggered bid windows, auto-ranking, and expiry. An Airtable API sync mirrors operational data for the non-technical team, while cron scheduling drives reminders, digest emails, and pipeline cleanups. RBAC ties it all together from the API level up.
keyFeatures: Three-role dashboards: Admin, Customer, Provider
Automated bid windows, ranking, and expiry
Airtable API sync for operational visibility
Cron scheduling for reminders, digests, and cleanups
Full audit trail of bid activity
RBAC from API to UI

title: EverNorth
shortDescription: CMS-driven website platform with a full admin panel for real-time content management, SEO optimization, and multi-user authoring.
description:
EverNorth is a CMS-driven website platform where every public page is generated from a structured content model. A full admin panel gives the team real-time content management — edits go live instantly with versioned drafts and multi-user authoring.

SEO optimization is built into the content model rather than bolted on: per-page metadata, structured data, and clean slugs come from the same UI that manages copy. A Node.js + MySQL backend serves pre-rendered pages quickly while keeping authoring fully dynamic.
keyFeatures: Full admin panel with real-time content management
Database-driven page generation from a structured content model
Built-in SEO fields: metadata, structured data, clean slugs
Versioned drafts with publish scheduling
Multi-user content authoring with roles
Fast pre-rendered public pages served by Node.js + MySQL
